verdict.rationale: Fireworks markets 'Run the latest open models with a single line of code' and 'instant access to the most popular OSS models' across a catalog of 100+ models. It also documents uploading models from Hugging Face yourself. However, nothing documents how quickly newly released open-weight models land on the platform. missing for 10: documented day-0 or time-to-availability commitments for new releases, concrete examples of recent models added shortly after launch, independent or hands-on corroboration of release speed.
